nudges.subject: Reminder: sign your Roth IRA beneficiary form
nudges.body: Hi Ada, a reminder that the beneficiary form for your Roth IRA is waiting for your signature. Sign where flagged and send it back through the portal, and Helen will take it from there.

nudges.subject: Your Edward Jones transfer: what to expect this week
nudges.body: Hi Kofi, most positions from the Edward Jones joint account arrive in kind this week. The Bridge Builder fund is sold first and comes over as cash. Once everything settles, we rebalance into your Growth 80/20 model.

nudges.subject: Your required distribution has been sent
nudges.body: Hi Erik, this year's required minimum distribution has been sent with 10% federal withholding, as you asked. You'll see it on your next statement.

nudges.subject: Call prep: next year's distribution date
nudges.body: Confirm next year's RMD date and withholding, and invest the Fidelity account in Meridian Income once it lands.

nudges.subject: Your Q3 fee, explained
nudges.body: Hi Maeve, here is how your Q3 advisory fee was calculated: the average daily balance across your accounts, at your household's tier. We've also asked to waive this quarter's fee for the delayed rebalance and will confirm once it's approved.

nudges.subject: Schwab transfer submitted
nudges.body: Hi Maeve, your Schwab account transfer was submitted today. Most transfers complete in about a week; we'll text you when it lands.
